entities.name: Kazuhisa Kawaguchi

entities.summary: Kazuhisa Kawaguchi  is a Japanese former Nippon Professional Baseball pitcher. In February 2023, he was hired by his former school of Tottori Jōhoku High School, to train its baseball team.
